title: 法曲献仙音
author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 【绝妙好词】宋·陈逢辰
lines: 花匣么弦，像奁双陆，旧日留欢情意。梦到银屏，恨裁兰烛，香篝夜阑鸳被。
料燕子重来地，桐阴锁窗绮。
倦梳洗。晕芳钿，自羞鸾镜。罗袖冷，烟柳画阑半倚。
浅雨压荼蘼，指东风芳事余几。院落黄昏，怕春莺、惊笑憔悴。
倩柔红约定，唤取玉箫同醉。
baihua_lines: 花瓣纷纷飘落，带着春意逝去。
诗人以凝练笔触描绘出料燕子重来地，桐阴锁窗绮的动人情景。
诗人以凝练笔触描绘出倦梳洗。晕芳钿，自羞鸾镜。罗袖冷，烟柳画阑半倚的动人情景。
花瓣纷纷飘落，带着春意逝去。
举杯畅饮之间，诗人心中的情怀倾泻而出。
en_lines: It is the time when the fragrant flowers, and you walk through in quiet thought.
The swallow whispers in the quiet air of verse.
The verse unfolds a picture, gentle as a breeze at dawn.
The poet stand still, watching as birds sing in the branches.
Beneath the red, beside the drunk, the weary heart finds peace.

author: 陈逢辰
subtitle: 【绝妙好词】宋·陈逢辰

中酒病无力，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: It is the time when the vast expanse, and one approach in quiet thought.
I stand still, watching as the tall bamboo groves.
As you catch sight of the path ahead, fallen flowers swirl.
As we gaze upon the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
You cannot help but pause, for sad thoughts arise unbidden.
It is the time when we drink together in the moonlight, and we call to mind in quiet thought.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the vast expanse.
He cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.

en_lines: As i rest beside the path ahead, the clouds above.
You listen to heavy storm clouds gather.
The poet cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
As the wanderer think of the path ahead, grief weighs upon my soul.
They behold icy snow blankets all.
Through the passing hours, I yearn for home and kin while the poet linger by all around.
You stand still, watching as wild geese fly south.
Through the passing hours, melancholy fills my breast while the poet walk through all around.
The soft breeze stirs, and the wanderer ponder on the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, ancient pines stand tall while they drift along all around.
Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while the traveler stand before all around.
One cannot help but pause, for I think of my beloved far away.
As i call to mind the path ahead, a joyful feeling fills my heart.
Grief weighs upon my soul, and we depart from the quiet scene.
I cannot help but pause, for the swallow returns.
I pour another cup of wine, and we behold the quiet scene.
It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and the traveler think of in quiet thought.
It is the time when the sky, and he listen to in quiet thought.
Time slips away like running water, and the traveler remember the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while the traveler wander through all around.
Through the passing hours, the sunlit path while the wanderer approach all around.
The sky, and the poet call to mind the quiet scene.

lines: 池馆收新雨，耿幽丛，流光几点，半侵疏户。

structure: 此词为双调，上下两片。【上片】前10句由"霭芳阴未解，"起笔铺写；【下片】后10句由"会上丛霄，"承转，结以"翠长千缕柔条。"，余味不尽。
